sections.h2: Plastics carries most of the $19.6 billion feedstock deficit

chart.title: Plastics widened to a $14.6 billion deficit while organic chemicals narrowed
chart.sub: FY2025-26 deficit, exports minus imports, USD billion.

sections.means: The Chapter 39 plastics deficit widened from $14.0 billion to $14.6 billion while the Chapter 29 chemicals deficit narrowed to $5.0 billion.
sections.todo: Keep the chapter split visible in future trade tracking, since the combined headline hides the widening plastics gap.

sections.h2: Specialty fibres, Indutech and Mobiltech show the largest FY2025-26 deficits

chart.title: Three segments carry the largest net deficits in FY2025-26
chart.sub: Net trade balance by technical-textile segment, FY2025-26, USD million.
chart.source: DGCI&S TradeStat, commodity-wise, matched to the 314-code segment mapping.

sections.means: Specialty fibres and composites has the largest net deficit at $396M, ahead of Indutech at $325M and Mobiltech at $310M.
sections.todo: Prioritise these three segments for feedstock and capacity support, as the post's segment table recommends.

sections.h2: Indutech's deficit nearly tripled in one year, to $325 million

chart.title: Indutech's net deficit grew from $112M to $325M in a single year
chart.sub: Indutech net trade balance, USD million.
chart.source: DGCI&S TradeStat, commodity-wise, FY2024-25 and FY2025-26.

sections.means: Indutech moved from a $112 million deficit in FY25 to a $325 million deficit in FY26, and the post links the segment to LLDPE and HDPE dependence.
sections.todo: Lock multi-year feedstock offtake contracts before new LLDPE and polyester capacity comes online.
